entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • File-based apps: dotnet run reuses cached build when a required dependency DLL is missing #56747
  • Backport distinct Copilot CLI and VS Code agent detection to .NET 10 #56745
  • [WebToolsE2E][.NET 11 GA] .NET 11 GA carries lower-than-expected implicit .NET 10/9/8 runtime versions #56736

Closed

  • Publish command is treating .NET Framework web project with new SDK project file format as a .NET Core project #10101
    Discussion
  • [WebToolsE2E] Hot Reload changes are not reflected in browser with dotnet watch on .NET 11 RC2 #56428

PullRequests

Created

  • Add adaptive CI failure attribution skill #56746
  • Capture binlogs from SDK test scenarios #56744
  • Add SDK-generated fallback for the Hot Reload settings endpoint #56743
  • Warn when targeting .NET 11 in Visual Studio 18.11 or earlier #56742
    Servicing-consider, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.4xx' #56741
  • Fix dotnet watch diagnostics when device discovery fails #56739
  • Warn about forward slashes in template symbol and choice names #56738
  • Preserve template verifier command error codes #56737
  • tasks: sign OpenHarmony ELF build outputs #56735
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed

Merged

  • Update MTP and MSTest to include read-side pipe disconnect fix #56731
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Make optimized Native AOT publish opt-in #56661
    Servicing-approved, 11.0.0
  • Validate trusted ProgramData workload paths #56740
  • Drain watch test process output through stream EOF #56727
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix SDK test validation reliability #56627
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56521

Updated

  • Add `dotnetup <> install` under `admin` mode MVP #56664
  • Fix endpoint tests under compression-like temporary paths #56725
  • Update .NET 11 installer minimum Visual Studio version #56729
    Servicing-consider
  • Externalize localized resources from the NativeAOT CLI #56378
  • Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #56621
  • Pin .NET 8 and .NET 9 stable branding runtime versions #56647
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #56728
    Servicing-consider
  • Stabilize SDK layout metadata and JSON finalization #56704
